cookbooks.title: Getting Started with Stagehand Python + Valkey
cookbooks.h1: Getting Started with Stagehand Python + Valkey
cookbooks.lead: Use the Stagehand Python SDK with a Valkey-backed server so that act() and agent() actions are cached and replayed without LLM inference on subsequent runs.

cookbooks.title: Cache Categories and TTL
cookbooks.lead: Understand how Stagehand namespaces cached actions into act and agent categories, configure key prefixes for multi-tenant setups, and set TTL to expire stale entries automatically.

cookbooks.title: Production Configuration
cookbooks.lead: Configure TLS, ACL authentication, and environment variable-based setup for deploying Stagehand with Valkey in production or via the Stagehand server.
